summary: Phase 20 converts the Phase 19 multi-pass modeling policy from documentation into machine-enforced bridge invariants in bridge_cli.py verify-report.

invariants_implemented.description: Payload provenance: when a task has .bridge/payloads/<task-id>/manifest.json, verify author_role=controller, recompute SHA-256 of rhino.py at result_commit, require it to match manifest.sha256.
Unauthorized modification: when local_modeling_authorized is false/absent, reject if rhino.py or manifest.json changed between base_commit and result_commit.
Multi-pass activation: triggered when manifest carries a non-empty modeling_run_id.
pass_index must be a positive integer; pass_kind must be one of foundation|correction|detail_qa|hotfix|single_pass; requires_controller_review_after must be boolean if present.
Foundation pass (pass_index=1, non-hotfix): reject parent_task_id, parent_payload_sha256, parent_result_commit if present.
pass_index > 1: require parent_task_id, parent_payload_sha256, parent_result_commit. Resolve parent from base_commit (not operator modifications).
Parent report must exist at base_commit. Presence on base_commit is the machine signal that the controller reviewed and merged the parent pass.
Parent report result_commit must equal manifest.parent_result_commit.
Parent payload manifest must exist at base_commit. Parent manifest sha256 must equal manifest.parent_payload_sha256. Parent manifest modeling_run_id must match current.
pass_index must equal parent pass_index + 1 (sequential, no gaps).
Multi-pass tasks must commit .bridge/evidence/<task-id>/pass-evaluation.json at result_commit.
pass-evaluation.json fields task_id, modeling_run_id, pass_index, pass_kind, executed_payload_sha256 must match the manifest.
When local_modeling_authorized=false: reject if local_modeling_used=true or payload_modified_by_operator=true in pass-evaluation.

backward_compatibility.non_payload_tasks: No manifest at result_commit → all Phase-20 checks skipped. Existing reports pass unchanged.
backward_compatibility.single_pass_payload_tasks: Manifest present but no modeling_run_id → provenance checked, lineage and pass-evaluation skipped.
backward_compatibility.protocol_version: 0.3 — no version bump required. Checks are additive.

new_command.name: next-pass-context
new_command.description: Non-mutating helper. Reads parent report + manifest from current checkout, prints JSON with modeling_run_id, next_pass_index, parent_task_id, parent_payload_sha256, parent_result_commit, parent_pass_kind. Does not author geometry.

files_changed.change: Added hashlib+subprocess imports; PAYLOADS, EVIDENCE, SHA_RE, VALID_PASS_KINDS constants; _git_show_bytes, _git_show_json, _check_payload_provenance, _check_multipass_lineage, _check_pass_evaluation helpers; extended cmd_verify_report; added cmd_next_pass_context; added next-pass-context dispatch in main().
New file. 14 fixture-based tests covering all major invariants and backward-compat cases using temporary Git repositories. No live Rhino or network access required.
Added provenance fields: local_modeling_used, local_modeling_authorized, payload_modified_by_operator, provenance_check. Defaults represent normal controller-authored workflow.
Added enforcement notice in core principle section.
Added machine-enforcement notices for payload and lineage checks; updated pass-evaluation path to canonical .bridge/evidence/<task-id>/pass-evaluation.json.
Updated multi-pass loop note to specify canonical pass-evaluation.json path and note machine enforcement.

validations.json_valid: All modified JSON files validated via json.load
validations.rhino_runtime_unchanged: No Rhino/MCP runtime implementation files modified

known_limitations: verify-report does not check that result_commit is a real git object (it checks format only). A fake 40-char hex SHA passes format checks. This was pre-existing behavior and is out of scope for Phase 20.
next-pass-context reads from the current working tree, not a specific commit. Controllers should run it from a clean up-to-date checkout after the parent pass is merged.
The parent report presence on base_commit is used as the proxy for controller review/merge. There is no protocol-level signature; a manually inserted report file would satisfy the check.
Pass-evaluation schema is validated for key fields only; free-form fields like measurements and capture_artifacts are not schema-checked by verify-report.
